pageProps.title: Love in the Big City (2024)
pageProps.review: A review of the romance drama film 'Love in the Big City' released in 2024, containing candid impressions of the work's charm which was unexpectedly worth watching even without prior information.
pageProps.content:
## Review I was a bit flustered as I watched it without knowing the content at all. I even watched it thinking the male actor was Lee Je-hoon after seeing the poster briefly.
I didn't expect much, but it was unexpectedly worth watching. But I don't think I'll read the original novel.
